description: This file is a shell script that automates performance benchmarking of an Android application, including setup, device configuration, UI interaction, and data collection, specifically tailored for 'ai.openclaw.app'.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the environment.

methods.name: adb_cmd
methods.description: Runs an adb command, optionally with a specific device serial.

methods.name: dump_ui
methods.description: Dumps the current UI hierarchy to an XML file.

methods.name: ui_has
methods.description: Checks if the UI contains a pattern.

methods.name: wait_for_pattern
methods.description: Waits until a pattern appears in the UI or times out.

methods.name: ensure_connected
methods.description: Verifies that the app is in a connected state.

methods.name: ensure_screen_online
methods.description: Ensures the screen tab is in online mode.

methods.name: ensure_chat_online
methods.description: Ensures the chat tab is active and online.

methods.name: capture_mem
methods.description: Captures memory info for the app.

methods.name: start_cpu_sampler
methods.description: Starts CPU sampling in the background.

methods.name: summarize_cpu
methods.description: Processes and summarizes CPU usage data.

methods.name: summarize_gfx
methods.description: Processes and summarizes graphics rendering data.

methods.name: measure_launch
methods.description: Measures application launch times over multiple runs.

methods.name: run_screen_benchmark
methods.description: Performs screen transition or scroll performance tests.
